rows.qualification_required: M.Sc. (completed at the time of joining) in Electronics/Physics/Nanotechnology/Materials Science / or related disciplines OR B.Tech/B.E. (completed at the time of joining) in Electronics/Electrical/VLSI/ECE/Nanotechnology / or related disciplines.

Upload scanned copies of documents to prove age, qualifications, experience, and other relevant details. Ensure all particulars furnished are correct in all respects before final submission. Submit the application online latest by 25.10.2026. Keep a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

content_sections.text: Scanned copy of documents to prove age Scanned copy of educational qualifications (M.Sc. / B.Tech / B.E. certificates and mark sheets) Scanned copy of experience certificates (if applicable)

content_sections.heading: KUDSIT Assistant Electronic Engineer Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Applications without attaching scanned copies of required documents shall be summarily rejected with no further chance for submission. Incomplete applications or applications without filling relevant fields will be summarily rejected. Original documents must be produced as and when called for by the University. Anything not specifically claimed in the application against the appropriate field will not be considered at a later stage. No interim queries after application submission will be entertained. Candidates will be intimated about the test or interview schedule through their registered email only. Canvassing in any form will entail cancellation of candidature.

faq.question: Q1. What is the KUDSIT Assistant Electronic Engineer recruitment?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment notification for 3 Assistant Electronic Engineer posts under an ISRO-funded research project at Kerala University of Digital Sciences Innovation and Technology.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under this notification?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies available for the Assistant Electronic Engineer post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply online?
faq.answer: The last date to submit online applications is 25.10.2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the essential educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold an M.Sc. in Electronics/Physics/Nanotechnology/Materials Science or related disciplines, OR a B.Tech/B.E. in Electronics/Electrical/VLSI/ECE/Nanotechnology or related disciplines, completed at the time of joining.

faq.question: Q5. What is the upper age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 35 years as of the last date for submission of application, with age relaxations of 5 years for SC/ST and 3 years for OBC candidates.
